_comment: What ends up in the shipped UI bundle without being an npm `dependency` (MR-1685), for
scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs. `assets`: files from this repository that are
third-party works; `file` must exist, `texts` are paths under third_party/licenses/.
`devPackages`: devDependencies whose own code the build copies into the bundle; their licence
files are read from node_modules (`cutAt` drops everything from that line on, e.g. Vite's list
of the dependencies it bundles into its own build tool, none of which ship in the app).
Checked against `vite build` output on 2026-10-14: the font file, Tailwind's banner and
Preflight in the CSS, Vite's modulepreload polyfill in the entry chunk, rolldown-runtime-*.js.

assets.name: Inter
assets.what: the UI font (Inter Variable, "Version 4.001" in its name table)

devPackages.what: Preflight, the base styles Tailwind compiles into the UI stylesheet
the module preload polyfill Vite adds to the UI entry script
